# Cross-mart data trust

This report is produced after the gate (`assert_marts_ready`), contracts and
reconciliation steps have passed. It summarises Tier 0 trust signals only.

## Profile

Per-mart column profiles (row counts, nulls, distincts) are written to
`tables/profile_<mart>.csv` by the `profile` step.

```{r}
#| echo: false
if (has_run) {
  profs <- list.files(file.path(run_dir, "tables"), pattern = "^profile_.*\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)
  for (p in profs) {
    df <- utils::read.csv(p, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    cat("\n###", basename(p), "\n\n")
    print(utils::head(df, 20))
  }
} else {
  cat("No run tables found. Run `Rscript main.R` first.\n")
}
```

## Reconciliation — transactions vs KPI

Money must reconcile to the cent. Any non-zero `diff` is a hard stop.

```{r}
#| echo: false
rec <- read_table("reconciliation_txns_vs_kpi")
if (!is.null(rec)) print(rec) else cat("No reconciliation table in this run.\n")
```

## Period completeness

Missing months break forecasts and YoY comparisons.

```{r}
#| echo: false
comp <- read_table("completeness")
if (!is.null(comp)) print(comp) else cat("No completeness table in this run.\n")
```

## Freshness / DQ gate

The `gate` step refuses to analyse marts that are empty, unreadable or stale.
If this report rendered, the gate passed for the configured marts.
